1.s: God’s power has given us everything for life and godliness. Add to faith goodness, knowledge, self-control, perseverance, godliness, kindness and love. Peter recalls the transfiguration; prophecy came from people “moved by the Holy Spirit”.
1.d: 1:20–21 is a key text on the origin of Scripture.

2.s: False teachers will arise, as false prophets did, and judgement will come on them as on the angels, the flood and Sodom.

3.s: Scoffers ask where Christ’s coming is. “One day is with the Lord as a thousand years.” God is patient, “not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.” New heavens and a new earth are coming.
3.d: Peter mentions Paul’s letters as Scripture that some twist.
